title: Host policy
description: Stack data of the host-session risk class (F3 B11, DC-09 amended), not a setting: the targets no host act may have, whatever the owner's host access settings say (the Stella vault), and how long a host presence record counts. bin/host_access.py decide reads it before the settings.

apps.description: App ids that are never a target.

domains.description: Domains that are never a target, with every subdomain.

presence_max_age_s.description: How old (seconds) a host presence record may be and still count for a host request (V1-05).
